baseline_incident_edges.relationship: Corbin reports Prost’s criticism that his historical practice gives insufficient attention to history’s civic and social mission.
baseline_incident_edges.evidence_note: Explicitly Corbin’s own recollection in the 2006 Vacarme interview, not a newly located text by Prost. Corbin acknowledges that the description may be right and explains his resistance to lessons-of-history arguments. His later 2013 interview also recalls Prost’s contrast between civic mission and writing for pleasure. This is a specific disagreement between colleagues, not generalized hostility or rejection of the quality of Corbin’s research.
